body:
Session 2026-08-29 (third). **R0 complete, R1 gate met for scribectl, evidence made durable.**
Supersedes fc52e5c2.

## Landing status — every repository touched

| Repo | Branch | State |
|---|---|---|
| agentops | main | clean, pushed |
| vuoro | main | clean, pushed |
| scribectl | main | clean, pushed |
| sprintctl | main | clean, pushed |
| kctl | main | pushed; `.envrc` untracked (pre-existing, not mine) |
| auditctl | main | pushed; `.envrc` untracked (pre-existing, not mine) |
| homelab-analytics | main | clean, pushed |
| aligned-equity | main | clean, pushed |
| outctl | release/2026-08-11 | clean; my work landed on **main**, checkout left where it was |
| hostproto | main | **1 unpushed commit, unpushable** — repo archived read-only |
| appservice | main | untouched by me |

Nothing is parked in a PR. `hostproto 4dd53e5` cannot be pushed (see below);
`git reset --hard` was blocked by the classifier, so it is yours to drop.

## What was done

**§10 item 6 — the loop, run manually.** §10 closed. Five measured operator
interventions, four environment drift, one substrate gap. Item #2324, PRs #17/#18
merged. The deliverable was the measurement.

**Landing policy made operative.** Claim `land-work-in-main` (practice,
standing-policy) with `basis_for: item-done, dispatch-build, pr-handoff-summary,
session-handover` — all four skills updated and synced. `session-handover` now
requires stating the landing status of every repo touched, which is why this note
opens with that table.

**R0 sprint #551 complete** — #2307, #2308, #2309, #2310, #2311 all done.

**R1 gate met for scribectl** (`docs/assessments/r1-gate-scribectl-2026-08-29.md`):
D1 and D6 hold with zero operator actions after a real process loss; D3 holds as a
*mechanism*; D2 holds for the three rooted repositories.

**Evidence made durable.** agentops, vuoro and scribectl now root
`AUDITCTL_ARTIFACTS_ROOT` at themselves, so shards and metanarrative model records
are committed and replicated by git. `check_append_only_shards.py` guards the
immutability that trades away.

**kctl's claims path made reachable.** Migration 9 + `kctl adopt`; `metanarrative.py
publish` now works for the first time.

**auditctl release unblocked.** `nix shell nixpkgs#postgresql` supplies `initdb`/
`pg_ctl` without sudo: 104 passed/10 skipped → **113 passed/1 skipped**.

## Do not re-derive these

- **`sprintctl[remote,served]`** — `remote` is psycopg, `served` is vuoro-client.
  AGENTS.md still says only `remote`. It is wrong and cannot be fixed durably:
  `/projects/dev/AGENTS.md` **is in no git repository**.
- **`authority_repo_uuid` is self-minted and unverified.** Any value is believed.
  That is the hole #2308's contract closes; it is a contract, not an implementation.
- **hostproto is archived** (GitHub, read-only, 2026-08-28) and split into six
  successors, **none of which has a dispatch manifest**. Wave 1 runs unonboarded.
- **The served audit substrate IS deployed and migrated** — `audit` schema on the
  vuoro database, principals provisioned, daily Hetzner S3 backup, restore drill
  rehearsed, **zero rows**. The gap is a *client*: auditctl's CLI is
  `add/list/rebuild/render` with no submit path.
- **Audit evidence is ~966 events, not 10,575.** The other 9,612 ndjson lines under
  `_artifacts/` are outctl terminal capture streams; no `outctl-*` directory has an
  `audit/` subdirectory.
- **Snapshots land on the same physical device as `/projects`**, retention has gaps,
  and the TrueNAS copy is a stale migration remnant, not a replica.
- **Empty is not absent.** Six instances today, four of them mine: `gh -R` returning
  empty with exit 0; `kubectl` with KUBECONFIG unset between tool calls; a query
  grepping deployment *names* for "audit" when the substrate is schemas;
  a case-sensitive grep that made me delete two live test assertions; a handoff probe
  reading `reservations` when the key is `active_reservations`;
  `sprintctl item status --status blocked` from `pending`, which silently no-ops.
  **State absence only when the channel demonstrably answered.**

## Open, with owners

- **sprintctl #2327** — `48deaee` binds the reservation-release actor to the
  authenticated identity. Unreleased, so the running `vuoro-shared` still lets any
  principal attribute a release to an arbitrary string in the durable record
  (evidence: scribectl item #2326, event #2620 reads `not-my-identity`). Needs a
  sprintctl release + vuoro-service redeploy. **Handed to the vuoro deployment
  session** with R1 bullet 4 (three digests still three, vuoro #2314).
- **auditctl 0.1.3 unreleased** — D3's rebuild guard exists only on `main`. Installed
  0.1.2 reports success while dropping index-only events, so D3 is unenforced
  everywhere. No longer blocked on verification.
- **`land-work-in-main` stays contradicted** until CI runs on `main`;
  `verify.yaml` is `pull_request`-only. Sequences behind the
  `git.apps.kotona.app` runner move, which is the standing decision.
- **agentops has 4 stashes and 3 `test_instruction_doctor` failures** — the failures
  are another session's in-flight escalation-vocabulary work (`af71e20`), not mine.
  One stash is mine and now redundant; I did not guess which to drop.
- **Twelve scopes still unrooted**, including `bindery-core`, `sprintctl`,
  `auditctl`, `kctl`. Same one-line `.envrc` change.

## What is next

**R2 — does the seam generalize?** Its gate is *no repo-specific branch in Vuoro,
sprintctl or auditctl core*. The precondition already looks good: scribectl's entire
enablement was an `authority_repo_uuid` and one `.envrc` line, both repo-owned
config. R2 needs a second consumer; the six hostproto successors are the obvious
candidates and are unonboarded.

**`align-and-converge` remains encoded and failing** (`ec0ecdc`), ten hard gates,
nothing implements it. The plan recommends a *second* scenario for durability-class
drift, and adding two cases to this one: a stale installed tool whose version string
matches while its behaviour does not, and a default kubecontext pointing at a
different cluster than the claim is about.

**acceptance-lab's `CONDITIONAL`** still carries no machine-readable conditions,
owner or expiry.
